suspects.description: Pointer value `in_stack_fffffe10` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.
Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep.

Watcom dead self-copy guard: `if (&local_ec != &local_d4)` wraps an unconditional struct copy. Both addresses are stack locals — always different — so the guard never skips. Drop the if-wrapper in a .keep.
